data.one_liner: A sandbox for building and testing Flutter widgets and screens in isolation.
data.what_it_does: Widgetbook lets you develop UI components and full screens without running the whole app. It lets you mock hard‑to‑reach states, catalog widgets, and run visual golden tests across devices and themes.
use_when: You need to design or iterate UI components quickly
You want visual regression (golden) testing for widgets
You want to share a UI library or component catalogue with designers or other developers
avoid_when: You only need runtime business logic or state‑management solutions
Your project is tiny and adding a full UI sandbox feels heavyweight
strengths: Easy isolation of widgets for rapid UI development
Built‑in support for golden/visual regression tests
Integrates with Widgetbook Cloud for sharing and CI
weaknesses: Adds extra tooling and build steps to the project
Primarily focused on UI, not on state‑management or backend logic
May increase CI time due to visual test generation
